spec.headline: GTA 6 HAS |10.3M PRE‑ORDERS|?
spec.topic: Sensor Tower estimate: 10.31M digital console pre-orders for GTA 6 as of 11 Nov 2026 (7.71M on 2 Nov); CD Projekt: Cyberpunk 2077 passed 8M pre-orders (Dec 2020, 74% digital). Unconfirmed by Rockstar/Take-Two.
